SELECT a.clia, a.pfi, a.lab_name facilityName, Nvl(a.flag_serves_nyc, 'N') nycLab, a.laft_staff staffName, pkg_trk_common.fn_get_fullname (u.last_name, u.first_name, u.middle_name, NULL) laft_staff_name, clobbytes(b.interaction_notes) comments, To_char(b.interaction_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY') as communicateDate, c.communication_type_description communicationType FROM lab_physical_facility a LEFT OUTER JOIN lab_interaction_history b ON (a.pfi = b.pfi) LEFT OUTER JOIN coded_lab_communication_type c ON b.communication_type = c.communication_type LEFT OUTER JOIN nyehms_users u ON (a.laft_staff = u.legacy_uid and u.end_date is null) WHERE a.pfi != '-999' AND Trunc(b.interaction_date) BETWEEN To_Date(#{p_from_date}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') AND To_Date(#{p_to_date}, 'MM/DD/YYYY') ORDER BY interaction_date, pfi

SELECT a.clia, a.pfi, a.lab_name facilityName, Nvl(a.flag_serves_nyc, 'N') nycLab, a.performs_dta performDTA, flag_blood_bank donorLab, b.approval_status_desc apporvalStatus, a.laft_staff staffName,a.address, a.city, a.state, a.zip FROM lab_physical_facility a LEFT OUTER JOIN coded_lab_approval_status b ON (a.approval_status_code = b.approval_status_code) WHERE a.pfi != '-999' ORDER BY b.approval_status_desc
